criterion: Errors name the cause and fix
description: `client operation` with malformed --request JSON returns `INTERNAL_ERROR` carrying the raw SyntaxError text; with --request omitted it returns `FORBIDDEN: This operation is not available to board credentials`. The standalone `pardner operation` handles the same mistake with `INVALID_ARGUMENT: --request must be valid JSON`.
expected: `INVALID_ARGUMENT: --request must be valid JSON` and `INVALID_ARGUMENT: Supply --request`.
actual: INTERNAL_ERROR (looks like a crash) and a misleading permission error.
suggested_fix: Parse --request with the same guarded helper cli.js uses and require it explicitly.

description: History and Activity describe issue links as 'Setup agent recorded task.link-issue on this task', exposing the raw operation type and omitting which issue.
suggested_fix: Add a sentence formatter for task.link-issue / task.unlink-issue events.
